name: ProvenExpert
desc: Collect customer reviews, send survey invitations, and pull rating data from ProvenExpert.

actions.name: get_rating_summary
actions.description: Retrieves the overall rating value and total review count for your ProvenExpert profile.

actions.name: create_survey_invitation_url
actions.description: Generates a personalised, one-time-use survey link that you can send to a customer.

actions.name: send_survey_invitation_email
actions.description: Sends a survey invitation email through ProvenExpert to a single recipient. A 7-day reminder is sent automatically unless disabled.

actions.name: list_surveys
actions.description: Returns all surveys on your ProvenExpert profile with their codes, names, and share links.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Retrieves the company and contact details of your ProvenExpert profile.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
